$comment: Single source of truth for public numbers. Fill metrics only from a measuring command and record that command in provenance under the same key. headline lists metric keys the README must state verbatim (tests/facts.test.ts). integrationsClaimed lists /api/health keys the copy relies on; integrationAliases maps a health key to vendor names used in copy (e.g. db: [MongoDB, Atlas]) so check_claims.py can catch unbacked mentions. Example: metrics.listingsScanned = 1662, provenance.listingsScanned = 'python ml/harvest.py --count (2026-09-26)'.
tagline: AI-proposed merge conflict resolutions that land only when both sides' intent survives and the tests pass.
